a11y.keyboardNote: Measured in a browser on 27/08/2026. Home, End, Enter and Space were delivered by the component and NOT declared — the same direction as G-A11Y-04. The measurement is per starting position: the component keeps the active item in its own state, so the probe prepares with one ArrowDown (the component's own flow) instead of focusing a DOM node, or the arrows appear inert. ArrowRight was confirmed from the first item, where a node with children exists.

props.name: items
props.description: The tree: {id, label, icon?, children?, hasChildren?}. Nesting is by containment — the group lives inside its treeitem, with no aria-owns to keep in sync. `hasChildren: true` makes a node openable before its children exist (one of the references calls it hasChildItems); the children arrive later through `items`.

props.name: defaultExpandedIds
props.description: Which nodes start open. Only the initial value: after that the tree owns its own expansion.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: The whole node, not just the id — you rarely want only the id.

props.name: onExpand
props.description: Called every time a node opens (never when it closes). If it returns a promise and the node has no children yet, the node shows the spinner where the caret was and is aria-busy until the promise settles. A rejected promise closes the node again, so opening it retries.

props.name: selectedId
props.description: Controls which node is selected, as in DependencyGraph. `null` means none. Without it the tree keeps the selection itself, as before.

props.name: className
props.description: On the root <ul>, which is the element with role="tree".
